name: Fairies
overview: The Bible does not teach the existence of fairies but emphasizes the reality of angels who serve God and watch over His people, especially the vulnerable, as seen in Matthew 18:10. Believers are warned against being led astray by worldly philosophies and traditions that are not rooted in Christ (Colossians 2:8), highlighting the importance of discernment. God's revelation through His angels, as in Revelation 1:1, confirms that spiritual beings serve His divine purposes, contrasting with fanciful or deceptive notions about supernatural creatures. Ultimately, salvation and deliverance come from the Lord alone, who brought His people out of bondage (Exodus 20:2) and offers eternal life through faith in Jesus Christ (John 3:16).
